description: This file defines a REST controller for a Spring Boot application, providing basic endpoints such as welcome message, API documentation redirect, health check, and application info.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A Spring Boot REST controller providing basic endpoints for welcoming, health checking, API documentation, and application info.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Returns a welcome message when the root URL is accessed.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Redirects to Swagger UI documentation page, preserving the original request scheme, host, and port.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Provides a simple health check endpoint returning 'OK'.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Returns basic information about the application.
